newsitem.title: JAPAN: Japan says to buy about 60,000 T of rice on Jan 9.
newsitem.headline: Japan says to buy about 60,000 T of rice on Jan 9.

text.p: The Japanese Food Agency said on Monday it would buy about 60,000 tonnes of rice at an import tender on January 9.
In a General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade deal in 1993, Japan agreed to gradually open its rice market, pledging to buy 455,000 tonnes of foreign rice in fiscal 1996/97, which ends on March 31.
"We'll fulfil all rice import requirements for this fiscal year (by the tender on January 9)," an official of the Food Agency said.
The agency, the grain trading arm of the Agriculture Ministry, is the sole importer of rice, wheat and barley.
